title: First Prompt to Lovable
summary: First prompt = goal + users + pages + style + constraints

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? The first prompt needs 5 parts: goal + users + pages + style + constraints.
- Why now? You have a wireframe — now turn it into a lovable prompt that understands you right away.
- What after the lesson? A prompt draft ready to copy — not code or programming.
- Lovable = a building assistant that reads your description and generates an interface. You describe — you don’t program.

sections.heading: Tension — 'Build an Interface' — it doesn’t turn out as you imagined
sections.subtitle: 'Build an Interface' — it doesn’t turn out as you imagined
sections.contentMarkdown:
- You wrote 'Build an AI Interface' — it produced bright colors and sections you didn’t want.
- Lovable builds exactly what you write — not what you wish for. 3 words = complete guess.
- The solution: Write a 5-part recipe — copy it into Lovable and see the result.

sections.heading: Core idea — The first prompt = 5 parts
sections.subtitle: The first prompt = 5 parts
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Goal: What type of interface and for what purpose?
- Users: Who will use it?
- Pages: Name the wireframe sections.
- Style: Colors, tone, mood.
- Constraints: What is not in the first version?

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms to Start
sections.subtitle: Two Terms to Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| Prompt Spec | The complete recipe — goal, users, pages, style, constraints | Like specifications for a tailor: size, color, number of buttons |
| Scope | What is in this version — and what is later | 'Only one page — Home' — not a complete site |

sections.heading: Quiz — Quick Confirmation
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
Question: You want Lovable to build only the Home Page — without login. What is the best part of the Prompt Spec?
Constraints: one page (Home) — without login in the first version.
'Build a complete site'.
Style: beautiful colors.
Explanation: Constraints + Scope define the limits — AI does not guess extra features.

sections.heading: Mission — Write the First Prompt for Lovable
sections.subtitle: Write the First Prompt for Lovable
sections.contentMarkdown:
Introduction: A draft for copying — not implementation. Use the wireframe from the previous lesson. 10-15 minutes. Submission: - Goal: [Type of interface + what it does]
- Users: [Who uses it]
- Pages: [Wireframe sections by name]
- Style: [Two colors + mood]
- Constraints: [What is not in the first version] Evaluation Criteria: | Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| All five present | 60% | Goal, Users, Pages, Style, Constraints — all written. Pages linked to the wireframe |
| Ready to copy | 40% | Style has at least two colors. Constraints specify 'not now' |
